config.description: Password for your Actual Budget server. Not needed if you set ACTUAL_SESSION_TOKEN

config.description: Session token for servers behind OIDC, which have no password. Use instead of ACTUAL_PASSWORD; if both are set, the token wins

config.description: Your budget's Sync ID, found under Settings > Show advanced settings

config.description: Only needed if your budget file is end-to-end encrypted

config.description: Set to 1 to hide every write tool from the model, exposing only reads and analysis

config.label: Set to chat to offer the 17 everyday tools instead of all 43, which is 17
config.description: Set to chat to offer the 17 everyday tools instead of all 43, which is 17.0 KiB of tool descriptions instead of 39.2 KiB on every connection. Defaults to full

config.label: Directory for the local budget cache
config.description: Directory for the local budget cache

config.label: How long to wait for your server to start replying, in milliseconds
config.description: How long to wait for your server to start replying, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000; raise it if a GoCardless bank sync is being cut off
